description: The dashboard centerpiece (tier 1). A synthesized, plain-language verdict of right-now household financial health with a 3-level worst-signal-wins status (good/watch/alert), one AI-authored warm sentence, and one hero number: this month's cash flow (money in minus money out). Replaces the old arbitrary mood-emoji and the standalone AI-nudge card. This is the ONLY card that floats and the ONLY one using typography.h1.

designSystem.statusAccent: 4pt (spacing.xs) left rail OR top gradient wash in status color at ~8% ({statusColor}14)

status.description: Overall status; 'setup' is the empty/new-household onboarding state

headline.description: AI-authored warm sentence, <=90 chars. Must never be empty; fall back to a per-state template if missing.

cashFlow.description: This month's cash flow = income - expenses. The hero number. Sign-colored.

scope.description: Which scope the numbers reflect; drives no visual change here but recomputes inputs

period.description: Label for the top-right control; fixed to 'this month' in v1

onPeriodPress.description: Forward-compat period switch; ship disabled-styled if not built

onCtaPress.description: Only used in 'setup' state — the Link-an-account CTA

setup.tone: onboarding; hero replaced by primaryGradient CTA button

worstSignalWins.rule: overall = severityMin(...) where good < watch < alert; any one alert => card is alert

checks.bills: good=all covered; watch=one due soon; alert=overdue/unpayable
checks.spending: good=within weekly budget; watch=<=~20% over; alert=well over
checks.cashFlow: good=positive this month; watch=flat/near zero; alert=negative

hero.note: Sign color is DECOUPLED from status color (a Good week can have any sign; a green number can sit in a Watch card)

sentence.note: Never dim; never duplicate the hero number verbatim; contextualizes it instead

stateTreatments.loading: glassFloating skeleton: chip line + 2 text lines + wide hero bar (reuse components/Skeleton.tsx)
stateTreatments.error: neutral glass (NOT floating): alert-circle-outline (colors.error), 'Couldn't load your status right now', Retry text button; STILL show locally-computed hero cash-flow number if available
stateTreatments.setup: chip SET UP; onboarding sentence; hero replaced by primaryGradient CTA 'Link an account' (radius.lg)

accessibility.label: Status: {statusWord}. {headline}. Cash flow this month, {positive|negative} {cashFlowAbs}.
accessibility.colorIndependence: status conveyed by chip icon + word + color together, never color alone
accessibility.reducedMotion: status accent + press use animation.fast; instant under reduce-motion
accessibility.dynamicType: sentence and hero reflow; hero uses min-height reserve, never fixed-height clip

developerNotes: If the status endpoint doesn't return {status, headline}, compute status client-side (worst-signal-wins) and use a deterministic per-state sentence template. Keep cashFlow locally computable (income - expense over current month) so the error state can still show a number.
